entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: Revolutionary Nacatl from Naya with mahogany fur and black stripes, believed long dead.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane containing the shard of Naya.

entities.name: Empire of the Clouds
entities.description: Structured Nacatl civilization Marisi called on his people to revolt against.

entities.name: Coil
entities.description: Strictures of the Nacatl civilization, housed in a white wall.

entities.name: Wild Nacatl
entities.description: Prides who followed Marisi and celebrated their animal natures in the jungle.

entities.name: Cloud Nacatl
entities.description: Nacatl who stayed in the cloudy mountain civilization.

entities.name: Festival of Marisi
entities.description: Yearly holiday of the Wild Nacatl celebrating Marisi.

events.summary: Marisi calls on the leonin to revolt against the Empire of the Clouds and the Coil, starting a civil war.
events.quote: Marisi called upon his fellow leonin to revolt against the Empire of the Clouds

events.summary: The white wall housing the Coil is broken and the race splits in two.
events.quote: The white wall that housed the Coil was broken, and the race was split in two.

events.summary: The Wild Nacatl march down from the mountains into the jungle.
events.quote: marching down out of the cloudy mountain peaks and into the jungle once more

relations.note: his followers became the Wild Nacatl
relations.quote: The prides who followed Marisi's beliefs, calling themselves the Wild Nacatl

relations.note: division persists with friction and fierce battles
relations.quote: which creates friction and fierce battles between prides
